Callout.Name: Armed Robbery - Pharmacy
Callout.Message: Armed robbery reported at a pharmacy.
Callout.Advisory: Suspect left on foot towards the estate, dark hooded top.

Script.Line: They made me do it. I am not going to say who.
Nobody in here is hurt. Nobody has been hurt.
I am putting it on the counter. Look, I am putting it down.

Lines.Approach: Male, dark hooded top, gone on foot towards the estate.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
